🎯 Today’s objective

By the end of this lesson I can...

✓ I can scale a recipe up or down (find ONE first)

✓ I can find the best buy (price of ONE)

✓ I can change pounds to euros and back again

So you never run out of food, or get ripped off abroad!

Abdul has £600 to exchange for Polish zloty (zł). The exchange rate is £1 = 5.15 zł. The bank only has 20 zł notes. What is the maximum amount of zloty Abdul can buy and what will this cost him in pounds? Give your answer correct to the nearest penny. You must show all your working.

Hint

Answer

Whole notes only.

Answer: 3080 zł for £598.06

Calculator

[6 marks]

A café makes 40 scones using 1.2 kg of flour. Flour is sold in 1.5 kg bags at £1.20 each and in 500 g bags at 45p each. The café needs to make 100 scones. What is the cheapest way to buy the flour, and how much cheaper is it than the other way? You must show your working.

Hint

Answer

Flour for ONE scone, then 100 scones.

Answer: Two 1.5 kg bags, 30p cheaper
